 Live .  53,042 viewing 53042 viewing Live page Updated 1 minute ago US Grand Prix: Antonelli leads but won't win title in Austin as it stands
 United States Grand Prix
 BBC Radio 5 Live
 Close United States Grand Prix
 BBC Radio 5 Live
 Listen live Live Reporting (active) 
 Leaderboard 
 Summary
 Kimi Antonelli leads US Grand Prix in Austin
 Antonelli will win title with race victory and George Russell finishing ninth or lower and Lewis Hamilton fifth or lower
 Russell eighth and Hamilton fourth
 Charles Leclerc second and Max Verstappen third
 Select 'listen live' for BBC Radio 5 Live commentary (UK only)
 Close form Send us your F1 views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Lorraine McKenna
 Team radio - McLaren to Norris published at 21:31 GMT 21:31 GMT 
 Engineer: "OK so we think we're gonna stay out. Hamilton likely will come through anyway. As long as we can get to the end, we still beat Hadjar."
 Norris: "Yeah, no problem."
 81 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:30 GMT 21:30 GMT 
 Lap 51/56 
 Down the inside at Turn One goes Lewis Hamilton on Lando Norris to take fourth place away from thte world champion - can both Ferraris end up on the podium tonight? 
 Valtteri Bottas seems to be in trouble in the Cadillac, and now the virtual safety car is deployed. The Finn is safely climbing out of car, which is parked up out of the way. 
 26 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:29 GMT 21:29 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Live in Austin 
 Max Verstappen was not able to do anything about that. Maybe Red Bull should have gone to the hard tyre when they had the chance. Maybe he's now run out of tyre, he doesn't seem to be able to defend and push as hard as the Ferraris can.
 266 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Leclerc takes P2 from Verstappen published at 21:28 GMT 21:28 GMT 
 Lap 50/56 
 Charles Leclerc has gone from fourth place up to second in only a few laps. The Ferrari driver reaches Turn 12 and takes Max Verstappen with a clean move. The Dutchman goes down to the final podium place after starting on the front row. 
 356 77 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:26 GMT 21:26 GMT 
 Lap 49/56 
 Kimi Antonelli is on his way to victory at Cota and while he can't win the title tonight as George Russell is in eighth place, he can seal it in Mexico next weekend by finishing ninth. 
 Lando Norris is in fourth now after being overtaken twice in quick succession and he tells his engineer no more radio messages. Silence, please. 
 230 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:24 GMT 21:24 GMT 
 Select the 'Get Involved' button to have your say 
 Will Mercedes bring Russell in so Kimi can be world champion?
 Phil, Spain 
 229 592 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Norris loses out to Leclerc published at 21:24 GMT 21:24 GMT 
 Lap 48/56 
 Lando Norris has lost out again, this time out of Turn 13. Charles Leclerc has more pace in his locker and is able to pass the McLaren driver for the final podium place. Norris has to settle for fourth. 
 Image source, Reuters 
 149 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Verstappen passes Norris published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Lap 47/56 
 Lando Norris suddenly finds himself under pressure from not one, but two cars. The world champion can't put up a fight when Max Verstappen pounces at Turn One, but he can just about hold off the Ferrari of Charles Leclerc. But for how long? 
 205 104 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Lap 46/56 
 Charles Leclerc is told he is fighting for a podium spot in Austin. The Monegasque driver is on six-lap old hard tyres, and now he's closed up on Max Verstappen and Lando Norris. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 253 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Lap 45/56 
 The fastest stopwatch is parked next to Charles Leclerc, but the Ferrari driver has Max Verstappen and Lando Norris in front of him before he can even think about catching - and passing - race leader Kimi Antonelli. His engineer thinks he has the pace to challenge, and now he creeps closer to the Red Bull and McLaren. 
 220 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:19 GMT 21:19 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Live in Austin 
 Max Verstappen does not look happy. It looks to me he's never been happy with the car in this race. It looks like he's struggling, it looks like it's a handful.
 304 95 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Lap 44/56 
 George Russell cannot afford any slip ups now. If he loses places from his P8 position, then championship leader Kimi Antonelli will secure the title tonight in Austin, as Lewis Hamilton is outside the top four in fifth spot. 
 140 47 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Lap 43/56 
 The trio of cars fighting for the podium places is giving Kimi Antonelli a chance to breathe out in front. The Mercedes driver is 14 seconds clear of Lando Norris in second, but the McLaren driver has Max Verstappen right on his rear wing. 
 165 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Team radio - McLaren to Norris published at 21:16 GMT 21:16 GMT 
 Engineer: "Ok Lando, so the situation is we're currently P2. Our better chance is just to make the one-stop work. Best way to defend against Max is the yellow [tyre]."
 143 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Lap 42/56 
 Charles Leclerc is the man to keep an eye on. The Ferrari driver in fourth is part of the Lando Norris-Max Verstappen train, and Leclerc has now been told he'll be able to catch the Red Bull in third in about six laps' time. 
 155 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:14 GMT 21:14 GMT 
 Lap 41/56 
 Lando Norris is getting fed a very long message by his McLaren race engineer. The world champion has been on the hard tyre for a while now, but the teamthink the one-stop is the best bet to a podium finish. Norris is 14 seconds off race leader Kimi Antonelli. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 136 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:12 GMT 21:12 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Live in Austin 
 That was a stunning stop from Ferrari. 
 247 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:12 GMT 21:12 GMT 
 Lap 40/56 
 Ferrari get Charles Leclerc in and out quickly with some fresh hard tyres, and the Monegasque driver takes his place in fourth spot. 
 That stop moves Lando Norris up to second place behind Kimi Antonelli, with Max Verstappen running in third after his changeover a few laps ago. 
 122 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:11 GMT 21:11 GMT 
 Lap 39/56 
 Lewis Hamilton makes another stop in this race and takes on the hard compound. The seven-time world champion heads out and is now behind the Red Bull of Isack Hadjar in sixth place. 
 Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc in second will be next to make a tyre change. 
 183 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:10 GMT 21:10 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Live in Austin 
 You don't want to win a championship by getting just enough points. Antonelli knew he had to win this race and he's leading it and doing everything he possibly can and to make sure he's heading in the right direction. It's an impressive performance, not just by Mercedes but Kiimi Antonelli as well who's just been brilliant. His season has been incredible. He's doing everything he can, there's nothing he can do about the guys behind him.
